risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions commodity price volatility as a major risk affecting revenues. WTI prices varied from 64.73 USD in 2025 to 75.76 USD in 2024, directly impacting royalty revenues and depreciation needs (768 million USD in 2025).

risks.title: Operator and buyer credit risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly identified in the text. Two operators each accounted for more than 10% of revenue in 2025 and 2024. The absence of specified collateral indicates dependence on partner creditworthiness.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: The company issued 1.6 billion USD of Senior Notes in July 2025 and has a 1.5 billion USD revolving credit facility. Exposure to variable rates on certain facilities affects future financing charges.

risks.title: Proved reserve estimation risk
risks.score_rationale: Oil and gas reserve estimation involves complex subjective judgments. These estimates directly impact depreciation calculations and valuation of strategic acquisitions such as Sitio (4 billion USD).

risks.title: Derivative instrument risk
risks.score_rationale: As of December 31, 2025, the company holds a net derivative asset position of 21 million USD on derivative contracts. The text indicates that derivative gains can be offset by changes in actual production value, creating imperfect hedge risk.

risks.title: Short-term energy outlook uncertainty risk
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions heightened levels of uncertainty regarding short-term energy outlook. This macroeconomic risk weighs on overall operations and acquisition planning.

ai_positioning.summary: VNOM does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
